content.text:
Looking at this request: the codebase has no `seen` field — `WatchItem` (and the whole watchlist flow: `watchedCount`, `toggleWatched`) uses a `watched` boolean, so I'll interpret the request's "seen" flag as `watched`. The change naturally splits into two units:

1. **watchlist-store** — the core logic: a new `clearWatched()` method that removes every watched item and persists, mirroring how `remove()` behaves.
2. **watchlist** — the UI: a "Clear watched" button in the watchlist view that calls the store's new method.

No other unit touches watched-item removal, so no other changes are needed. I'll pin both halves with acceptance tests (store logic + persistence; a real button rendered in the component that actually clears the list when clicked).

input.reason: The request's "seen" flag corresponds to the existing `watched` boolean on WatchItem (there is no `seen` field; the store already tracks watchedCount/toggleWatched). Core removal logic belongs in watchlist-store as a new clearWatched() method; the button belongs in the watchlist view, which is the only place the list and its watched summary are rendered. No other unit is affected.

steps.instruction: Add a public method `clearWatched(): void` to `WatchlistStore`. Behaviour: remove every item whose `watched` flag is true, preserving the relative order of the remaining items; the `items` signal and the derived `count` / `watchedCount` signals must reflect the change; persist the resulting list to localStorage exactly the way `remove(id)` does (so a freshly constructed WatchlistStore loads the reduced list). When no item is watched it must leave the list effectively unchanged. Do not change the behaviour of `add`, `remove`, `toggleWatched`, the storage key, or any existing test. The watchlist component will call this method from a new button, so the signature must be exactly `clearWatched(): void`.

The store gains `clearWatched(): void` this round (it removes every item with `watched === true` and persists). Expose a public `clearWatched(): void` method on the Watchlist component that delegates to `this.store.clearWatched()`. Add a `<button>` element to the watchlist template (near the summary/progress area or wherever fits the existing layout) whose accessible name contains the word 'Clear' — e.g. label it 'Clear watched' via its text content or aria-label — and whose click calls the component's `clearWatched()`. The button must be functional (not disabled and not hidden) whenever at least one movie is watched, and it must be the only control in this view whose accessible name matches /clear/i so a text-based lookup finds it unambiguously. Optional polish: you may disable it while `store.watchedCount() === 0`, and if the existing `announcement` signal is your pattern for action feedback, announce the number of cleared movies there. Do not change or remove any existing test, and do not alter the behaviour of toggleWatched / remove.
